summary: Set the UI language of the signed-in user
description:
The UI sends it after a sign-in when its language differs from the stored one. Mails to the user go out in this language. No audit entry is written.

Needs: a signed-in session (API tokens are refused)

language.description: One of the UI language codes: en, de, zh, fr, es, pt, ru, it, nl, pl, ja, ko, uk. Another value is answered with 400

400.description: Not one of the language codes

403.description: Not allowed: API tokens are refused here, use a signed-in session. The answer is an error with the message `API tokens cannot manage users`.
